name.en-US: Vexilla Regis: A Book of Devotions and Intercessions
name.pt-BR: Vexilla Regis: Livro de Devoções e Intercesões

description.en-US: Benson's war-time prayer book (1914-15), a compilation of intercessions: forms of prayer for every day of the week (for a just issue, the dead, the dying and wounded, prisoners, the destitute, sinners and enemies, and Our Lady's patronage over the realm), and general and particular devotions.
description.pt-BR: O livro de orações de Benson do tempo da guerra (1914-15), uma compilação de intercesões: fórmulas de oração para cada dia da semana (por um desfecho justo, pelos mortos, pelos moribundos e feridos, por prisioneiros, desamparados, pecadores e inimigos, e pelo patrocínio de Nossa Senhora sobre o reino) e devoções gerais e particulares.

sources.edition: Vexilla Regis: A Book of Devotions and Intercessions (London: Longmans, Green, 1914), Internet Archive full-text OCR (vexillaregisaboo00unknuoft).
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1914, so the text is public domain.

title.en-US: Part I: Forms of Prayer for Every Day of the Week
Sunday: For a Happy and Just Issue
Tuesday: For the Dying and Wounded, and Those Who Tend Them
Wednesday: For Prisoners, the Timid and Anxious
Thursday: For Widows, Orphans, the Hungry and Homeless
Friday: For Sinners, and for Our Enemies
Saturday: For Our Lady’s Patronage on Behalf of Our King and Realm
Part II: Devotions, General and Particular
